text: After Tokens 2026 | AI Economy Infrastructure Conference Skip animation AT _ November 10, 2026 / San Francisco Register now The AI Economy Infrastructure Conference Register now Speakers from OpenAI, OpenRouter, Databricks, Vercel & more ↓ After Tokens Meter. Control. Build. ↗ Break it open Tokens are just the beginning. Attendees from NOV 10 . What happens after the model call? Tokens tell you what the model consumed. They don’t tell you what a customer can use, when an agent should stop, or how a contract becomes a limit in your code. That’s the infrastructure we’re here to talk about: metering, credits, entitlements, pricing, billing, and the systems that keep them in sync. After Tokens brings engineers together for one day in San Francisco. Technical talks, architecture breakdowns, and lessons from systems running in production. November 10, 2026. In person at Terra, San Francisco. Hosted by Stigg. More speakers coming soon. Register now The people behind the meter . First speakers Engineers and leaders from OpenAI, Databricks, WRITER, and more. The people building what happens after the model call. ↗ Jonah Cohen Tech Lead for Financial Engineering ↗ Peter Walker Head of Insights ↗ Kyle Poyar Founder ↗ Vidhi Agrawal Director, Commercial Capabilities ↗ Lakshmi Subbramanian Head of Financial Infrastructure ↗ Dor Sasson CEO ↗ Jerome Z. Register now Attendees from Engineers and leaders from these teams are joining us on November 10. Terra . Venue A two-level gallery venue in SoMa, on Rincon Hill. Twenty-foot ceilings, walls of factory windows, and an outdoor patio for the conversations between talks. Where Terra SoMa, San Francisco When Tuesday, November 10, 2026 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM PT Getting there A short walk from Embarcadero BART and the Salesforce Transit Center Bring what you built . Call for proposals A system you shipped. Something that broke. What you learned. How do you meter an agent run? What broke when you moved from tokens to credits? How do you check entitlements without slowing the request down? We want the architecture, the implementation, and the tradeoffs. A narrow problem explored deeply. Something another engineer can take back to their own stack. Talk about the migration, the production incident, or the edge case nobody warned you about. No product pitches. No generic “future of AI” talks. A few details. Who is this for? + Engineers building AI products and the systems behind them. Backend, platform, and AI infrastructure teams, technical founders, and engineering leaders. The talks should be useful to someone writing the code. Is this a Stigg user conference? + No. Stigg is bringing the room together. The conversation is about how AI products get measured, controlled, packaged, and paid for, across teams and stacks. You don’t need to use Stigg. When and where? + November 10, 2026, from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, at Terra in SoMa, San Francisco. One day, in person. The schedule will be announced. How do I attend? + Register here to attend. We’ll confirm your spot by email. See you November 10 . Registration One day, in person, in San Francisco.
